Introduction

Annie is a South Korean-American singer under The Black Label. She is a sub rapper and oldest member of the co-ed group ALLDAY PROJECT, with whom she debuted on June 23, 2025, with the single "FAMOUS".

Annie was also one of MEOVV's pre-debut member.
